target: NFL regular-season home outright win, overtime included, ties excluded
roster_convention: Unweighted prior-week roster, stable player identifiers, no actual same-game snaps. Week 1 excluded.
estimator: Training-standardized ridge logistic regression, fixed penalty 10, no test-period tuning
evaluation: Earlier-seasons-only walk-forward; final selected season reserved in code. Retrospective source timestamps remain unverified.
randomized_control: Stable SHA-256 player-ID assignment independent of actual birth sign
